No two peaks anywhere in this file are closer than 0.600342 Th, yet the fragment tolerance is 0.00722706 Th near m/z 361.353. That is what low-resolution (ion trap) MS2 read with a high-resolution tolerance looks like, and it yields almost no tags for a reason the output cannot show. If the MS2 is ion trap, try -fragment_tolerance 0.3 -fragment_tolerance_unit Da.
